## Safety

- `rig performance simulate` prints `SIMULATION — NO EXTERNAL ACTIONS WILL BE EXECUTED` and never talks to OBS, Ableton, MIDI, Stream Deck, or macOS.
- `rig performance preflight` is advisory and never gates `rig now --play`.
- `rig performance plan` compiles effect order without executing.
